notes.title: Patch Note Announcement
notes.content:
We are aware that users on the Steam version of DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT are experiencing network errors and log in issues when trying to access DRAGON BALL CARD WARRIORS after purchasing Platinum Coins.
We are currently working on a update patch which will fix this issue and allow users who have already encountered this issue to log in properly. 

Until then, please do not purchase Platinum Coins on the Steam version of CARD WARRIORS.
Users who have encountered the issue will receive the correct amount of Platinum Coins for their purchases after the issue is fixed.

We apologize for the inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: DRAGON BALL CARD WARRIORS is now live!
notes.content:
Starting today, you will be able to challenge other players online with the new free update adding the DRAGON BALL CARD WARRIORS mode.

Build your deck with a mix of character and event cards, use ingenious tactics and summon the most powerful warriors to defeat your opponents. All players will start with 40 cards (x3) and will be able to collect more than 260 different cards!

Get a stronger start by collecting all the cards scattered across the world of DRAGON BALL Z: KAKAROT to earn up to 100 tickets and unlock bonus playing cards.
 
Three different online modes will be part of DRAGON BALL CARD WARRIORS:

[list]
[*] Casual Mode - where players can play random games against other players without rank consideration 
[*] Ranking Battle Mode - for more important stakes, players can try the Ranking Battle mode, where winning or losing impacts their rank 
[*] Tournament Battle - A monthly event where players are separated into three opposing teams. Players from the best team will get an exclusive reward! 
[/list]

Get more details on this new mode with this explanatory video:

[previewyoutube=Q33VcZ2xj-w;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Hello Z Warriors! A new patch has been released for [b]Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot[/b]. 
Update 1.04 implements the following fixes:

[b]LOADING TIME[/b]
[list][*] Reduced Loading Times when travelling from one area to another[/list]

[b]OTHER FIXES[/b]
[list][*] Fixed issue where players were unable to accept the Sub Story “Telekinesis Training” (Saiyan Arc Episode 3), if you saved and loaded your Save Data after fighting Tien
[*] Fixed issue that caused the Main Story icon to not be displayed if you saved and loaded your Save Data after clearing the Main Story “The Longest Three Hours” (Saiyan Arc Episode 5)
[*] Fixed issue where Chi-Chi couldn’t be found on the field if you accepted the Sub Story “Goten’s Growth” (Buu Arc Episode 1) and cleared the Main Story without completing the Sub Story
[*] Fixed issue that caused characters related to the Main or Sub Story to not appear if that specific character is already found within the field as a Villainous Enemy[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35812483/8b91b10525267942e5db6d0cc16a973fdecb76cd.jpg[/img] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35812483/8d475b7690a39bf4e43d970a4a5b314f43eac0a0.jpg[/img] 

Thank you for your support and stay tuned for more updates!
